name: BATTLE PASS BURST RARE
note: GVT battle pass screen, the backdrop behind the prize (CARD-BPP round 9, design/battle-pass-projector-1123): the burst in blue, whole, as the screen shows it at one moment. Five groups on the wide board, each with its origin at the burst's middle: the paper and its still rays, three sheets of lines (on the screen they fly outward), the glow.
